subject: Exhibit E rebalancing and implementation scan
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@edgescale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <contracts@edgescale.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exhibit E — proposed capacity rebalance and timeline scan

Marissa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Summarizing EdgeScale's ask so we have it in writing: we'd like to reallocate 40% of our committed GPU hours from the burst pool to a sustained pool for the next two quarters (Exhibit E). The goal is to stabilize inference latency for a new feature launching in Q3.

Can you share the process to get a change order executed (order of approvals: sales -> finance -> legal?) and an estimated timeline for implementation (config change, testing window, and date it would reflect in billing)?

Attached is a short internal note with our preferred start date (2027-06-01) and a proposed phased cutover plan. We'll need invoice alignment for June if possible.

Appreciate a quick scan and next steps — Amelia

Attachments: ExhibitE_rebalance_proposal.pdf (proposal, 2 pages)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@edgescale.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exhibit E — proposed capacity rebalance and timeline scan

Hi Amelia —

Thanks for the note and the doc. Quick answers so you can plan:
- Process: Sales (we) capture the change order -> Finance issues the updated invoice terms -> Legal reviews redline and signs MSA/Order Form exhibit amendment.
- Timeline: For a simple reallocation we can target ~3 business days for sales/finance ops once sign-off, plus a 5-business-day implementation window to validate traffic patterns. If you want the June 1 effective date, we should aim to have the change order fully executed by 2027-05-24 to allow for billing/validation.

Karthik and Neha, can you review Amelia's proposed phased plan and draft a short exhibit amendment? I'll coordinate the implementation schedule with our infra team.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft redline for Exhibit E and draft change order

Amelia / Marissa —

Please find attached a first-pass redline (ExhibitE_redline_v1.docx) and a companion change order doc (ChangeOrder_EdgeScale_CO-0427.docx). Key points in the redline:
- Move 40% of committed burst hours into sustained pool for line item ES-GPU-1; show effective date 2027-06-01 (subject to signature).
- Billing: prorated adjustment for June; finance to confirm final proration amount.
- Implementation: 5 business days for config and smoke tests, with automatic fallback to prior routing for 48 hours if anomalous latency is observed.
- No changes to data residency or SLA language.

Neha — please flag any legal concerns; looking to keep this as an Exhibit amendment rather than a full MSA change. If legal is happy, Marissa can cut the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments: ExhibitE_redline_v1.docx, ChangeOrder_EdgeScale_CO-0427.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft redline for Exhibit E and draft change order

Karthik / Marissa —

Quick review: redline looks straightforward. A couple of suggested edits I added inline in ExhibitE_redline_v1:
- Clarify the rollback trigger: change "anomalous latency" to a metric-based trigger (p95 latency > 800ms for two consecutive 5-min windows).
- Add a sentence to billing proration: "Finance will calculate the proration based on actual usage and agreed unit rates for the adjusted pools." Keeps expectations clear.
- Minor language: remove reference to "burst pool" in a few places and use the committed pool identifiers to match the Order Form numbering (ES-GPU-1A / ES-GPU-1B).

I don't think we need an RFI or SOC update for this change. Once you confirm those edits, I'll sign off from legal and we can send to EdgeScale for countersignature.

Neha
